text:
alex: Ok team — scheduling EU traffic rebalance dry run tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Aim: shift 25% of EU traffic from eu-edge-old -> eu-edge-v2 for next 40m. I will trigger. Need smoke owner + rollback watcher. TL;DR: incremental 10% steps every 10m, TTL 30s, canary on eu-west-1 first.
maria: I'm happy to own smoke checks. I'll watch latency and error rate. Which dashboards to use?
alex: Use Console -> Routes -> eu-rebalance-dryrun dashboard. Metrics: 99th latency, error-rate, request-rate, and 429 spikes. Preflight checklist in runbook: https://console.redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-rebalance. Also ping @jun for rollout script.
jun: Got it. I'll be by keyboard 01:30 UTC. Script is the same as last week, here's the dry-run command: 
```bash
./deploy-rebalance --env=prod --region=eu --target=eu-edge-v2 --steps=10,10,5 --ttl=30
```
This does not update DNS; it uses the routing service. We'll switch to DNS weights after dry run.
tara: Quick Q — what's the rollback plan if 5xx spike? 
alex: Rollback: run `routectl revert eu-rebalance-1768001234` or set weights back to baseline in Console. Also we have circuit-breaker fallback: policy auto-fails to baseline if error-rate > 2% sustained 3m. I will keep manual override ready.
deploy-bot: scheduled job created by jun:rebalance — dry-run at 1768001234, notifier channel #eng-platform. :white_check_mark:
maria: preflight done — smoke dataset uploaded, canary prompts ready. Also requested increased log retention for 1hr.
jun: small note — TTL change on DNS will be 30s only if we flip to DNS later. For routing service TTL irrelevant.
alex: final ask — code review ping: @tara can you ack the RL policy PR? It tweaks weight escalation timers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/812
tara: acked, left one comment about metric thresholds. Will resolve by EOD.
maria: I'll post smoke checklist here 30m before. :thumbsup:
alex: perfect. See you all at 02:00 UTC. If anything goes sideways, call on-call and we'll cut weights back immediately.
